newsitem.title: USA: Lesco plant closure will cause 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Lesco plant closure will cause 1996 loss.

text.p: Lesco Inc said on Friday it will move its manufacturing operations from Sebring, Fla., to a new plant in Ohio, taking a $6 million charge for the fourth quarter of 1996 that will help push the company into the red for the year.
The company said it would report its financial results February 19, and they would include a net loss for fiscal 1996.
The Sebring plant will close in October 1997. The new plant in Streetsboro, Ohio, will begin production in mid-year, employing up to 225 people. Lesco makes golf-course and turf-care products.
The Streetsboro plant will be operated by Commercial Turf Products Ltd, Lesco's joint venture with MTD Products Inc.
